Magewell Clamp Scope

__SUBTITLE__

Capture
Drag to pan, wheel or pinch to zoom, double-click to reset. Hover for values.

Markers: ticks on the top edge are line starts (drawn when zoomed in), purple triangles are detected jumps (> 90 codes between adjacent 32-sample means), the shaded band is a re-centring pulse as logged (the clamp actually switches about 0.3 ms later). Residual subtracts the sine fitted to each channel, which makes clamp kicks and the audio interface's ultrasonic content visible. Strip: per-millisecond min/max band and mean for the whole run, so the slow DC behaviour shows.
